label: Pain mirror (Meta/IG square)
copy_brief: A 'pain-mirror' Meta/Instagram feed ad for a high-functioning woman 40-55 who did everything right and still doesn't feel like herself. Name the quiet burned-out feeling she already has, then offer the product as the calm way back to herself. Eyebrow = a short symptom callout. Headline = the emotional mirror (the 'before' feeling), 4-9 words. Subhead = one line that turns toward relief using 'supports' framing. CTA = short action. Warm, intimate, premium (A24), never clinical, never medical.
